name: 02370 · Rockland, MA
findings: ZIP 02370 (Rockland) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02370 (Rockland) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 02370 (Rockland) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 50% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.
